intended_object: The marked generator σ of the profinite group ⟨σ, τ | σ τ σ⁻¹ = τ^q⟩ (Iwasawa's presentation of the tame Galois group of a local field), i.e. the image of the free generator σ in the presented profinite group. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: `IwasawaGroup K` is the presented profinite group on generators indexed by `ULift (Fin 2)`. In `iwasawaRelator`, index 0 plays the role of σ: the relator is `of 0 * of 1 * (of 0)⁻¹ * (of 1 ^ q)⁻¹`, i.e. σ τ σ⁻¹ τ^{-q}. `iwasawaSigma` is `presentedProfiniteGroup.of _ (ULift.up 0)`, the image of the generator with index 0, so it is σ. This matches the relation proved right after it, `iwasawaSigma_mul_iwasawaTau_mul_inv` (σ τ σ⁻¹ = τ^q). It also matches the coordinate map, which sends σ to the generator of ℤ̂, as it should for the image of a Frobenius lift. This is one specific element of one specific group, so there is no question of generality. Mathlib has no presented-profinite-group counterpart.
